description: Debug tracing workflow - traces execution flow, identifies root causes of failures, applies fixes, and verifies resolution through regression testing.
author: ProjectZeroDays (All-Knowing Deity)

steps.description: Trace execution flow from entry point to failure point, identify root cause of each bug
steps.action: Trace execution flow from entry point to failure point using debuggers, logs, and stack traces

steps.description: Apply fixes for each identified root cause, verify each fix resolves the issue
steps.action: Apply fixes for each identified root cause, verify each fix resolves the issue without introducing new bugs

steps.description: Run regression tests to verify all fixes work correctly and no regressions introduced
steps.action: Run full test suite to verify all fixes work correctly and no regressions introduced
